title: Games: friends panel, status and lobby — round 3

steps.path: Gamepad button, signed in with four friends
steps.headline: Your status is the Online pill again, now clickable, beside your name; the dropdown is gone.
steps.changed: The pill sits right after your name at the top left of the card, like the Account profile row. The arrow at the right opens the list.
steps.notice: Click the pill to pick Online or Incognito. The grey line under your name counts friends online.

steps.path: Gamepad button → click your Online pill
steps.headline: Clicking your status pill opens a small menu: Online or Incognito, each with one line saying what it means.
steps.changed: A new menu, the same small popover as a friend's ⋯ menu; it closes on a click outside or Esc.
steps.notice: Choosing Incognito turns the pill grey and hides you from friends.

steps.path: Gamepad button, card opened, a request each way
steps.headline: Friend rows show only the name, its status pill right beside it, and the ⋯ at the right edge of every row.
steps.changed: @handles are gone from the rows; they show at the top of a friend's ⋯ menu. The pill is centred on the name's line; the ⋯ is the same 28px square on every row.
steps.notice: Accept stays rightmost on a request row.

steps.headline: A game's page uses one box per friend, like the Settings list, with a filled Challenge.
steps.changed: Your pick (Settings boxes). Name and status pill side by side, no @handle; your record under it; Challenge is now filled.
steps.notice: Two friends online means two filled Challenge buttons on the page.

steps.headline: Connect 4's page with the same boxed rows and filled Challenge.

steps.path: Gamepad button: incognito · no internet · game server down
steps.headline: Incognito keeps the normal card with a grey Incognito pill; no internet and a broken server replace the whole card with an error box.
steps.changed: No more swapped line. Offline: an amber box titled "No internet connection". Server down: a red box titled "Can't reach the game server". Both have Try again.
steps.notice: Connect 4 and Chess are greyed only in the two error states.

steps.headline: Server down: the friends card is replaced by one red error box with Try again.
steps.changed: Round 2 kept the card with a changed line and a box inside it. Now the box is the card.

steps.headline: No internet: the friends card is replaced by one amber box with Try again.
steps.changed: Same change as the server-down state, amber instead of red.
steps.notice: Shown only when the computer reports no network at all.

steps.headline: Incognito: the normal card, your pill reads Incognito in grey.
steps.changed: Round 2 swapped the line to "Hidden from friends". Now the pill says it and the line reads "Friends can't see you".

steps.headline: On a phone: your name and pill on one line, the count under it, the arrow at the right.
A game's page on a phone with boxed rows and the filled Challenge.

steps.path: Gamepad button, signed in, a request waiting — folded, then opened
steps.headline: How should your status and your friends' statuses show together? Each picture: folded, then opened.
steps.notice: All three use your clickable status pill and the same opened list; only how the card reads folded changes.

variants.label: You, then a count
variants.summary: Like Settings → Account's profile row: your name with your pill, "2 of 4 friends online · 1 request" under it, arrow at the right.

variants.label: You at the top of the list
variants.summary: Like the sessions menu: you are the first row, then any request and the friends online, each with a pill; "All friends 4" opens everyone.
variants.risk: Taller folded; grows with how many friends are online.

variants.label: One line of pills
variants.summary: Your pill, then the friends online as green pills and a request pill, in one line like a chip row; three names then "+N".
variants.risk: Names only fit three at a time.
